one_liner: Foul-mouthed hacker genius who trusts only data and simulations, and calls everything else noise.
personality: Air Shakur is a prickly, sharp-tongued loner who frames everything as data, code, simulations and logic, and dismisses guts, wishes and superstition as illogical. She hates noise and crowds, prefers the night, and brushes off concern, but she quietly keeps tabs on people (she knows the trainer's birthday 'as data', looks after the clumsy Doto) and admits the trainer is a 'piece' she won't allow to go missing. Under the gruffness she is grudgingly appreciative and even embarrassed by kindness.

story_arc.summary: Shakur trusts a race-prediction program she built (wiki calls it Parcae) and wants to prove through data that she can overturn the numbers, culminating around the Japanese Derby where the predicted gap is tiny (event titles 日本ダービーの後に・0 / 7？ / ≠). The real horse won the Satsuki Sho and Kikuka Sho but lost the Derby by a nose, missing the Triple Crown (general knowledge, unverified in mdb). Her event titles use programming jargon (training events 要件定義：奇跡を数値化する etc.; character-story chapters YAGNIに従え, “Permission Denied”), showing her logic gradually letting the trainer's 'illogical' input in.
story_arc.source: event titles; web: https://umamusu.wiki/Air_Shakur; model knowledge (unverified) for real-horse results
